items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Monsieur Berry looked as though he was Hitler's twin brother... He was a very nice person and really enjoyed our company.

ctx.x: I was never a heavy beer drinker but I drank less alchohol during our stay in Knocke than at any time after I learned how to really drink. There was a cafe in the casino building down stairs under the terrace of the casino that served good German beer called Dortmund and after every set, most of us made a bee line for this cafe which was called Berry's.
Monsieur Berry looked as though he was Hitler's twin brother. The same little moustache and he combed his hair in the same style as Hitler. He was a very nice person and really enjoyed our company.

Johnny Mitchel, Burns, Joe Hayman, Ted Fields and myself were the most regular customer, of Berry's cafe and we must have drank at least a gallon and a half of Dortmund between us every night. I was actually getting a kick out of beer for the first time in my drinking life.
